history.summary: Listed as a '1BR' but the 1,151 sqft size is a dual-key (1+study/2-bath) layout in a small 116-unit freehold boutique — the low $1,199 psf is a size artifact, not value. With null URA appreciation/transaction data and a tiny development, this is exactly the thin-data boutique the rubric warns against.
history.rating_rationale: All URA fields are null (no appreciation rate, no txn count, no median PSF), so the high score_1000 of 939 rests on neutral-filled missing data, not evidence — the technical signal here is hollow. Web check confirms Suites @ East Coast is a 116-unit freehold completed ~2012-2014 and this 1,151 sqft 'cheap-PSF 1BR' is really an oversized dual-key unit; the $1,199 psf is low only because the unit is large, not because it is good value. Tiny 116-unit dev = shallow liquidity, and $1.38M is a high quantum for a 1BR-classified unit. No verifiable appreciation evidence on an investment thesis means no basis to buy.

history.summary: The headline -44.1% age-adj 'cheapness' and -32.9% cohort discount are unreliable: this 1,151 sqft 'beds:1' unit is really a large unit (Suites @ East Coast 1BRs are 377 sqft; 1,151 sqft falls in the 3BR band of 904-1,787 sqft), and the cohort discount was computed on psf_cohort_txns=0 (zero comparables). A large unit's lower PSF is normal, not a verified bargain.
history.rating_rationale: Listing $1,380,000 / 1,151 sqft = $1,199 psf vs project recent-12mo range $1,709-$1,967 psf (avg ~$1,847). That gap looks huge but is mostly a size effect: the project average is dominated by 355-377 sqft studios/1BRs that trade at premium PSF, while a ~1,151 sqft unit naturally prints far lower PSF. With psf_cohort_txns=0 the algo had no same-size comparable, so the -32.9% premium is against nothing. D15 is a genuinely good forward region (realized fwd RCR ~+3.5%, East Coast desirable), and freehold, which is a real positive, but I cannot certify the discount is real without a same-size resale comp. bedroom_sqft_mismatch and very_low_psf flags both fire.
red_flags: 1,151 sqft labeled 'beds:1' but matches the project's 3BR size band (904-1,787 sqft) - mislabel/mis-scrape

very_low_psf is partly a size artifact (large units trade at lower PSF than the studio-heavy project average)
appreciation_pct 6.49% over only 19 txns - thin, treat as story not forward signal
